decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. In particular the shutter laths shall be perforated as indicated on the drawing hereby approved.

Condition : 3 - The proposed installation of new roller shutter to existing shop front because of its position, size and appearance would be considered to relate well to the surrounding streetscape and would be in accordance with both policies ENV-B.1.1 All new Development and S.4.2 Shop Front Design of the Unitary Development Plan adopted 2003
Condition : 4 - 4	The proposed AC unit and associated condenser will not operate before 08.00am Monday - Saturday and not after 19.00 Monday Friday and at no time on Sundays.
description: Installation of new roller shutter to existing shop front.
